content.short: BitDegree is a leading Web3 education hub.
content.description: BitDegree has stood at the forefront of Web3 education since 2017, delivering innovative and user-friendly learning solutions. It has reached over 45 million users worldwide, empowering individuals with the knowledge and skills to thrive in the evolving digital economy. Its Web3 Missions program is the latest adventure, providing essential Web3 knowledge through an incentivized and gamified learning journey that makes mastering complex topics engaging and approachable.
